mapper.sql: case when ck_winner in ('red', 'blue') and ck_winner = ck_side then 1 else 0 end
case when (ck_side = 'red' and ck_winner = 'blue') or (ck_side = 'blue' and ck_winner = 'red') then 1 else 0 end
mapper.select: with base as () select extract(month from ck_date) as month, ck_position as position, count(*) as participation_count, sum() as win_count, sum() as lose_count from base group by extract(month from ck_date), ck_position order by month

with base as (), meetings as ( select distinct b.ck_id, b.ck_date, b.ck_winner, b.ck_side, o.ck_streamer from base b join ck_participant o on o.ck_id = b.ck_id and o.ck_side != b.ck_side and o.ck_position = b.ck_position and o.ck_streamer != #{streamerNo} ), totals as ( select ck_streamer, count(*) as match_count, sum() as win_count, sum() as lose_count, max(ck_date) as last_match_date from meetings group by ck_streamer ) select * from ( select t.ck_streamer as streamer_no, s.streamer_name, s.streamer_soop_id, t.match_count, t.win_count, t.lose_count, t.last_match_date from totals t join streamer s on s.streamer_no = t.ck_streamer order by t.match_count desc, t.win_count desc, t.last_match_date desc, t.ck_streamer asc ) where rownum <= 5
